title: Active Budget Can Kill Sensitivity: Diagnosing and Repairing TopK Sparse Autoencoder Reliability
abstract: arXiv:2609.37857v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are increasingly scaled to wider dictionaries to recover fine-grained structure from large language model activations. However, a feature is useful for interpretation only if it remains a stable unit of analysis when the same meaning is expressed in different surface forms. We study this reliability question for TopK SAEs via feature sensitivity. Experiments demonstrate that scaling selectively reduces the sensitivity of rare features, while common features remain comparatively stable. A controlled width\(\times k\) factorial experiment identifies the active budget k as the root cause: the degradation arises from the selection boundary rather than dictionary width alone. We attribute this failure to the geometry of TopK selection. The active margin, the distance to the cutoff, predicts feature loss without thresholds. Guided by this margin diagnosis, we introduce pairwise rank stabilization. Our method targets

translated_title: 活跃预算可能扼杀敏感性：诊断与修复TopK稀疏自编码器的可靠性
translated_abstract: 稀疏自编码器（SAEs）正日益被扩展到更宽的字典，以从大语言模型激活中恢复细粒度的结构。然而，一个特征只有在对同一含义以不同表层形式表达时仍能保持为稳定的分析单元，才对解释有用。我们通过特征敏感性来研究TopK SAE的这一可靠性问题。实验表明，扩展字典会选择性地降低稀有特征的敏感性，而常见特征则相对稳定。一项受控的宽度×k因子实验确定了活跃预算k是根本原因：这种退化源于选择边界，而非仅仅源于字典宽度。我们将这种失败归因于TopK选择的几何特性：活跃边际（即到截止点的距离）无需阈值即可预测特征丢失。在这一边际诊断的指导下，我们引入了成对秩稳定化方法。我们的方法针对（原文此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文发现TopK稀疏自编码器在扩展字典时稀有特征失稳的根源是活跃预算k而非字典宽度本身，并据此提出基于活跃边际诊断的成对秩稳定化方法来修复这一可靠性问题。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies the active budget k—rather than dictionary width—as the root cause of rare-feature instability in TopK sparse autoencoders, and introduces pairwise rank stabilization guided by active margin diagnosis to repair this reliability issue.
